messages:
Tim (Partnerships): Kicking off a short sprint: validate LangChain + LlamaIndex adapters on GatewayX and FlowBridge, and get marketplace metadata ready. Minimal ask: smoke tests, one 90s demo clip, and marketplace manifest. Who owns what?
Maya (Eng-Platform): I can own staging infra and the manifest linter. Will create per-partner namespaces and ephemeral API keys (ttl 48h).
Jules (DevEx): I'll write the compatibility checklist. Key checks: tokenizer version, embedding dims, metadata passthrough, and streaming start time.
Priya (Product): Marketing needs a 75-char tagline, 3 bullets, and a 30s demo GIF. Also confirm whether marketplace needs pricing tier info.
Tim (Partnerships): Partners to provide adapter package + manifest by 2026-05-18. Demo scheduled for 2026-05-31 (internal). Public announce depends on partner legal.
Jules (DevEx): Quick smoke command to validate roundtrip + streaming seed:
```bash
curl -s -N -X POST https://staging.gatewayx.redwood/v1/stream \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $PARTNER_KEY" \
  -d '{"adapter":"llamaindex","input":"Summarize: Redwood mission"}' | head -n1
```
Expect HTTP 200 and first chunk <300ms.
Maya (Eng-Platform): I'll add a manifest schema that includes: name, tagline, logo_svg, hardware_compat (csv), tokenizer_version, model_config_ref. Validator will warn on missing fields.
Priya (Product): For marketplace pricing: include a free/pro/enterprise field. Partners can opt out if they want direct-sales only.
Tim (Partnerships): Risk: quantization mismatch on some partner hardware (L4 vs H100). Ask partners to list quantization tested (fp16/int8) and tokenizer used.
Jules (DevEx): Adding tests: embedding shape test, index reload test for LlamaIndex (small corpus), and a LangChain prompt-templating parity check. I'll push a tiny GH repo with tests.
DeployBot: [system] namespace created: isv-staging-2464 (ttl=72h).
Maya (Eng-Platform): Allocated 2 GPUs for per-partner load testing and enabled rate-limits on demo routes. Keys will auto-revoke after 48h.
Priya (Product): Timeline recap: assets due 2026-05-18; infra run 2026-05-19 to 05-23; dry-run demo 2026-05-30; internal demo 2026-05-31.
Tim (Partnerships): Action items: Maya infra + validator, Jules checklist + test repo, Priya marketplace copy + demo clip, partners: adapter + manifest + tokenizer info. Check-in Friday 10:00 PT. :handshake:
